title: Coder and agents keep the project board's Status in step when they claim and close issues
body: Owner, 2026-10-09: #11087 closed but stayed 'In Progress' on project 22. When Coder (openagents chat "work on #N") or our agents claim an issue it should set the issue's project Status to In Progress on every project the issue is in, Blocked with a reason when it waits on the owner, and Done when it closes. Until then scripts/dev/project-status-sync.sh fixes drift, and the project's built-in 'Item closed → Done' workflow should be enabled (NEEDS_OWNER).
